title: codec.rs: rename finalize() pure function to noun form
description:
The function `finalize` (line 268) is a pure function that computes the final one's complement checksum. Per Rust naming conventions, pure functions should use noun names (describing the result) rather than verb names (describing an action).

Current:
```rust
fn finalize(sum: u32) -> u16 {
```

Should be renamed to describe the result, e.g.:
- `ones_complement_checksum`
- `finalized_checksum`
- `final_sum`

File: `rust/lichen-schc/src/codec.rs`
Line: 268
close_reason: Applied fixes: buf.fill(0), .expect() on infallible try_into, renamed finalize to ones_complement_sum. cargo check and cargo test pass.
